rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP, matching a single user. It provided the tablet’s tracking number after confirming the correct order. For changes, the agent sought explicit confirmation before any write: attempted an exchange (which failed due to availability), then obtained confirmation and processed a return for the tablet with refund to the original gift card. It confirmed and canceled the pending charger order with a stated reason, and confirmed and processed the return for the delivered sneakers. All actions were performed on the authenticated user’s orders, and the agent used read-only checks before writes. No unsupported or fabricated information was given, and the user’s preferences (one thing at a time, minimal info) were respected. Thus the interaction meets the policy and completes the user’s requests correctly.
